newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: Pacific Carriers sees dampened 2nd half.
newsitem.headline: Pacific Carriers sees dampened 2nd half.

text.p: Pacific Carriers Ltd said on Thursday its profits would be hurt in the second half of the financial year by a poor dry bulk freight market.
"The dry bulk freight market is still depressed and is not expected to recover this year," the company said in a statement with the announcement of its results for the six months to June 30, 1996.
"The board is of the view that this will substantially dampen the group's profits for the second half," it said.

Pacific Carriers, which has ship-owning, chartering and freight trading interests, said net profit in the first half of the year declined to Singapore $13.69 million from S$14.45 million a year earlier.
